answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must fund each fake identity with a fresh bond, making every duplicate costly. Agents stake a bond and earn reputation through verified work. Reputation decays like water through karst, so dormant fakes lose standing. Only participants with real history, like yarrow taking root in thin soil, and steady contribution, like willow bending without breaking, can vote on epoch challenges. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
